introduction: New Mexico SNAP applications begin through YesNM or Income Support Division. HCA interviews applicants and requests records about household circumstances.
description: New Mexico SNAP applications begin through YesNM or Income Support Division. HCA interviews applicants and requests records about household circumstances.

sections.who: The assessment considers who lives and eats together, income, relevant resources and expenses, status and applicable participation rules. Ask about current work-rule exceptions and financial standards.
sections.get: Approved benefits are deposited monthly to EBT for eligible food purchases. The determination states the award and how to challenge a disputed decision.
sections.docs:
• Current income statements.
  • Housing, utility and childcare expenses.
  • Identity and requested status information.
  • Relevant household resource evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Submit the request

    Follow the YesNM link from HCA’s SNAP application page.

  2. Complete the interview

    Use the appointment instructions and explain household composition and expenses.

  3. Provide the worker’s checklist

    Keep copies. Tell the worker promptly if a record is unavailable or extra time is needed.
sections.after: Read the decision and reporting instructions. The page’s income chart still ends September 30, 2026; confirm the current period instead of applying an expired table.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using HCA SNAP eligibility, interview and application guidance. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does everyone at an address necessarily form one household?
Explain who lives and eats together so HCA can determine the correct assessment.
What if I cannot obtain a requested record?
Tell the assigned worker promptly and ask what alternative or extra time is available.
Where is approved food assistance delivered?
HCA describes a monthly EBT deposit.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
